about: Whiskers lying over his face, inside the outline (tools/face_whiskers.py). Coloured precisely as whiskers and otherwise ignored (weight 0) until they are added last. centreline: sub-pixel, 1 px spacing (pixel (c,r) covers [c,c+1)x[r,r+1)); sigma: Gaussian half-width across (px, as seen in the photo); depth_grey: how many grey levels darker than the fur beside it the line is (his whiskers are light: on white fur they show only faintly). inferred_entry: from the outside whisker's root end to where the line can be seen on the face (through the busy fur band) - inferred, owner review.
